definition.name: raw-dense
definition.description: No memory construction: embeddings over the raw turns.

definition.name: raw-hybrid
definition.description: No memory construction: BM25 and embeddings over the raw turns, fused.

definition.name: default
definition.description: Search the graph by relationship, bring the messages those facts were stated in, and add raw-turn retrieval.

definition.name: dense-wide
definition.description: More raw turns: top 40 by embedding.

definition.name: dense+neighbors
definition.description: Top 12 turns by embedding, each with the turn before and after it.

definition.name: rerank
definition.description: 60 candidate turns (BM25 and embeddings fused); a model keeps the 20 most useful.

definition.name: rerank-strict
definition.description: As rerank, but only the turns the model chose are kept.

definition.name: dense-reason
definition.description: Top 20 turns by embedding; the reader works through the evidence before answering.

definition.name: dense-wide-reason
definition.description: No memory construction: top 40 turns by embedding, and a reader that works through the evidence before answering.

definition.name: rerank-reason
definition.description: No memory construction: 60 candidate turns (BM25 and embeddings fused), a model keeps the 20 most useful, and the reader works through the evidence before answering.

definition.name: rerank-dense-reason
definition.description: 60 candidate turns by embedding; a model keeps 20; the reader works through the evidence.

definition.name: default-reason
definition.description: The default graph pipeline, with a reader that works through the evidence.

definition.name: full-context-reason
definition.description: The whole conversation, with a reader that works through the evidence.
